outline:
Syllabus
The course covers fundamental concepts of chemical kinetics in batch reactors or ideal flow reactors. Several learning goals are listed as follows: understanding rate laws and the kinetic parameters, determining kinetic parameters and mechanisms from kinetic data, understanding the effects of catalysts, mass transfer and heat transfer on kinetics. In addition, Students in class will learn about ideal reactor design and analysis.
schedule:
Schedule
W1： Overview of chemical kinetics
W2-3： Kinetics of homogeneous reaction
W4-5： Data about A turing to P
W6-7： Data about A+B turing to P
W8-9： Multiple reactions
W10：Temperature and pressure effects
W11-12：Heterogeneous reaction
W13-14：Catalytic reaction and adsorption
W15-16：Solid-fluid reaction
W17-18：Flow reactor and its design
